section.heading: Use of official mail by officials-elect.
section.text: In addition to government employees and elected officials as defined in § 2-701, the following officials may mail materials as official mail:

para.text: The Mayor-elect, as defined in section 1042 of the Mayoral Transition Act of 2026, effective October 2, 2026 (D.C. Law 26-189; 73 DCR 11735);
The Chairman-elect and members-elect of the Council.

annotations.annotation: For temporary (90 days) amendment of this section, see § 3 of Mayoral Transition Emergency Amendment Act of 2026 (D.C. Act 26-481, Nov. 9, 2026, 0 DCR 0).
